Class CLIFactory

java.lang.Object
lms.presentation.CLIFactory
public class CLIFactory extends Object
Factory class for creating the appropriate CLI implementation based on user role.

Returns AdminCLI for administrators and UserCLI for members and librarians based on the current authenticated user's role.

Version:
2.0
Author:
Majd

    • getCLI

      public static CLI getCLI(AuthService authService, UserService userService, BookService bookService, LoanService loanService, CDService cdService, JournalService journalService, NotificationService notificationService, AccountService accountService, LoanStatsService loanStatsService, LoanQueryService loanQueryService)
      Returns the appropriate CLI implementation based on the current user's role.
      Parameters:
      authService - the authentication service
      userService - the user management service
      bookService - the book management service
      loanService - the loan management service
      cdService - the CD management service
      journalService - the journal management service
      notificationService - the notification service
      accountService - the account management service
      loanStatsService - the loan statistics service
      loanQueryService - the loan query service
      Returns:
      a CLI instance appropriate for the current user's role
      Throws:
      IllegalStateException - if the user's role is unsupported
